newsitem.title: MEXICO: GFBancomer ups 1996 GDP growth estimate for Mexico.
newsitem.headline: GFBancomer ups 1996 GDP growth estimate for Mexico.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Bancomer, the second-largest financial group in Mexico, said on Thursday that it revised its estimate of of Mexico's GDP growth in 1996 to four percent, up from two percent.

"The encouraging GDP figure for the second quarter (7.2 percent) and greater financial stability allows for a forecast of positive annual rates of growth in the coming quarters, although less than the 7.2 percent registered," Bancomer said its monthly economic analysis.
"The forecast for growth in the GDP for 1996 is raised to about four percent," the analysis added.
Bancomer said its previous estimate for GDP growth in 1996 was two percent.
